scientific_role: Attach one fixed development lifecycle to every frozen V34R1 high-realized-cash-yield event. This is a mother-signal economic screen, not a portfolio replay or parameter search.

signal_scope.signal_time: the exact completed effective-date close recorded in each frozen candidate decision_at; all frozen Stage-A candidates currently carry 15:00

outcome_data.maximum_event_path: 126 global market sessions strictly after each frozen signal, additionally capped at 2021-06-30
outcome_data.2021_role: Path-completion buffer for late-2020 frozen signals only; no 2021 signal may enter.
outcome_data.path_completeness: The half-year cap is later than global signal_cal_idx+126 for every frozen candidate. A candidate with no post-signal path rows fails closed rather than being mislabeled NO_LEGAL_ENTRY; incomplete sellability remains an explicit non-completed outcome.

outcome_attachment.entry: Inspect global market cal_idx signal+1 through signal+3 in order. Fill at the first legal, fully valid, non-upper-limit coordinate open. Never fill on the signal bar.
outcome_attachment.target: The first later same-lineage legal coordinate high at least 1.10 times entry exits at exactly +10% gross, subject to the frozen sellability check.
outcome_attachment.fallback: At the first same-lineage row with cal_idx strictly greater than entry_cal_idx+20, process the open before same-day high. Exit at target if sellable open is at/above target; otherwise exit at coordinate open. Only an unsellable open may defer to a later same-day legal target touch.

development_gate.if_failed: Keep 2022-2024 closed. Still render and manually inspect every development chart under a separately frozen chart authorization, because the user's discovery protocol requires full visual anatomy before closing or compressing rules.
development_gate.if_passed: Still require complete chart review and a separately frozen causal rule before any 2022-2024 opening.

outputs.publication: same-parent temporary construction, complete audits, re-hash every bound input, then one atomic no-overwrite rename

prohibited: changing cash yield threshold, event family, cooldown, boards, direction, signal dates or candidate membership
same-bar entry, entry after signal+3, target/horizon/cost search, stop search or alternate execution
2021 signals, any row after 2021-06-30, or any 2022-2024 read
portfolio replay, threshold rescue, market-state filter or strategy combination
overwriting any V34 or V34R1 artifact
